predecessors.name: Songhai Empire
predecessors.text: Kaarta round Nioro du Sahel and Diangounté (the page gives no outline; Diafunu is inside the disc)

successors.name: Tukulor Empire
successors.text: Kaarta round Nioro du Sahel and Diangounté (the page gives no outline; Diafunu is inside the disc)

ledger.x: c. 1650: Massa founds the Bambara kingdom of Kaarta. Infobox "Founded c. 1650 by Massa, who ruled 1650-1710"; "Preceded by the Songhai Empire".
1754: the Coulibaly take over from the Massassi.
1777: Sira Bo makes Diarra a vassal.
1855: Diarra's tie to Kaarta ends with the kingdom.
April 1855: Kaarta ends with the execution of its last faama, Mamady Kandian.

wars.name: Kaarta-Segu wars
wars.outcome: Benefali (1710-1745) "fought a long war against Bitòn Coulibaly and the Segou Empire" (no years given); Foulakoro (1745-1754) was captured by Bitòn Coulibaly; Sey Bamana Coulibaly, who fled Segou in 1754, re-established Kaarta.

wars.name: Umar Tall's conquest of Kaarta
wars.outcome: Umar Tall's jihad took Nioro and ended the Massassi dynasty; the Bambara kingdom became the Tukulor Empire's second capital province.

certainty.note: The page gives no frontier; Kaarta is a disc round Nioro.
